user.description: Track how long each app or source is watched on your TVs. After setup, add each TV with "Add tracked TV".

abort.single_instance_allowed: Watch Time Tracker is already set up. Add more TVs to the existing entry.

init.title: App name overrides
init.description: One mapping per line: `raw value = Display Name`. Use `raw value = !ignore` to never count a value (for example a home screen launcher).

error.invalid_override: Line {line_number} is not valid: `{line}`. Use `raw value = Display Name` or `raw value = !ignore`.

data_description.name: Leave empty to use the media player's name.
data_description.extra_entity: Optional. A remote or media player that reports the current app when the media player doesn't.
data_description.default_mode: How sources on this TV are counted, unless you pick them in the next step.
data_description.grace_period: Short pauses up to this long count as watching.

sources.title: Counting mode per source
sources.description: Pick the sources on this TV that use the other counting mode. You can type an app that hasn't been seen yet.

data.count_while_open: Sources that count whenever they're open
data.count_only_while_playing: Sources that count only while playing

data_description.count_while_open: For sources that never report playing, such as HDMI inputs and game consoles.
data_description.count_only_while_playing: For apps that reliably report playing.

sources_cleared.title: Counting mode per source
sources_cleared.description: The default counting mode changed, so the previous list was cleared. Pick the sources on this TV that use the other counting mode. You can type an app that hasn't been seen yet.
